description: Signs in with GitHub and keeps settings, keybindings, snippets and the extension list in a private Gist.
signInWithTokenCommand: Sign In with a GitHub Token
viewRemoteCommand: Show What Is Stored on GitHub
gistDescriptionDescription: Description used for the private Gist that holds synced data. Change it to keep separate sync profiles.
excludeSettingsDescription: Setting keys that are never uploaded. `*` at the end matches a prefix, so `redCode.sync.*` excludes every sync setting.
includeExtensionsDescription: Include the list of installed extensions, and offer to install missing ones when restoring.
includeSnippetsDescription: Include user snippets from the snippets folder.
includeSecretDescription: Also upload settings whose key looks like a credential (token, secret, password, API key). Off by default: values are stored in a private Gist, but still leave GitHub.
autoPushDescription: Upload automatically a few seconds after a setting changes. Off by default; Sync Now is always available.
